runs.name: make-ldpc / encode / transmit / decode / verify pipeline on a small random code
runs.cmd: mkdir -p $BODY/build && cd $BODY/build && S=$BODY/upstream/tree && $S/make-ldpc ex.pchk 20 40 1 evenboth 3 2>&1 && $S/make-gen ex.pchk ex.gen dense 2>&1 && $S/rand-src ex.src 1 20x10 2>&1 && $S/encode ex.pchk ex.gen ex.src ex.enc 2>&1 && $S/transmit ex.enc ex.rec 1 bsc 0.05 2>&1 && $S/decode ex.pchk ex.rec ex.dec bsc 0.05 prprp 100 2>&1 && $S/verify ex.pchk ex.dec ex.gen ex.src 2>&1

stdout.text:
Number of 1s per check in Inv(A) X B is 9.3
Encoded 10 blocks, source block size 20, encoded block size 40
Transmitted 400 bits
Decoded 10 blocks, 8 valid.  Average 21.1 iterations, 4% bit changes
Block counts: tot 10, with chk errs 2, with src errs 2, both 2
Bit error rate (on message bits only): 1.500e-02
make: *** No rule to make target 'test'.  Stop.
